entities.summary: Seymour Parker Gilbert was an American lawyer, banker, politician and diplomat. He is chiefly known for being Agent General for Reparations Payments from October 1924 to May 1930, working to facilitate and ensure Germany's reparations payments to the Allies after World War One. Afterwards, in 1931, he became an associate at J. P. Morgan.
